description:
v1.0 | 2 gates | 2 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

The square root of a 2-bit number, rounded down.

Use this circuit in any creation that needs a square root of a whole number, for example in a calculator or in the arithmetic part of a computer.

It takes one binary number and returns its square root rounded down to a whole number, read least significant digit first. Numbers that are not perfect squares give the root rounded down.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the number = x 0-1.
Outputs (green gates): root = x 0.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: Every output is one XOR gate over AND gates of plain inputs: 2 ticks.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. The yellow input gates are not counted in the gates or the ticks: wire to them, or merge them away.
By: byggmesterPRO
